Decision: FOLD. Bucket: overcards-no-equity-MP-fold-MW. Qs9s has no pair, no draw, and no path to a winning hand on Ad6c2s against UTG's strong c-bet range in a 4-way OOP spot. CALL wastes 2.5bb on approximately 10% raw equity against a value-heavy range.

IP does help equity realization, but the combination of no draw and deep stack tips this toward folding.

Decision: FOLD. Bucket: overcards-no-pair-BTN-3way-fold. AcQs with one spade (no flush draw) on a two-tone flush board at 150bb SPR lacks sufficient equity density to call profitably. Despite being IP-closing, the reverse-implied-odds exposure and MP's draw-heavy c-bet range make folding the cleaner GTO play vs. CALL.
